mapper.sql:
SELECT DATE(a.started_at) AS stat_day, a.provider_key, a.route_key, COALESCE(a.model, '') AS model, COALESCE(a.character_id, 0) AS character_id, a.status, COALESCE(a.error_code, '') AS error_code, COALESCE(a.http_status, 0) AS http_status, a.was_fallback, 1 AS attempt_count, CASE WHEN a.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS success_count, CASE WHEN a.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS failure_count, CASE WHEN a.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cancelled_count, CASE WHEN a.was_fallback = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fallback_attempts, COALESCE(a.duration_ms, 0) AS duration_sum_ms, CASE WHEN a.duration_ms IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS duration_sample_count, COALESCE(a.ttft_ms, 0) AS ttft_sum_ms, CASE WHEN a.ttft_ms IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ttft_sample_count, COALESCE(a.prompt_tokens, 0) AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(a.completion_tokens, 0) AS completion_tokens, CASE WHEN a.prompt_tokens_estimated = TRUE OR a.completion_tokens_estimated = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS estimated_token_attempts, COALESCE(a.total_cost_usd, 0) AS total_cost_usd, CASE WHEN a.pricing_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS priced_attempts, CASE WHEN a.pricing_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unpriced_attempts, CASE WHEN a.cost_estimated = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS estimated_cost_attempts, CASE WHEN a.cost_partial = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS partial_cost_attempts, a.finished_at AS last_finished_at FROM app_generation_attempt a
a.started_at >= #{startAt}
UNION ALL SELECT d.stat_day, d.provider_key, d.route_key, d.model, d.character_id, d.status, d.error_code, d.http_status, d.was_fallback, d.attempt_count, CASE WHEN d.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN d.attempt_count ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN d.status = 'FAILED' THEN d.attempt_count ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN d.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN d.attempt_count ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN d.was_fallback = TRUE THEN d.attempt_count ELSE 0 END, d.duration_sum_ms, d.duration_sample_count, d.ttft_sum_ms, d.ttft_sample_count, d.prompt_tokens, d.completion_tokens, d.estimated_token_attempts, d.total_cost_usd, d.priced_attempts, d.unpriced_attempts, d.estimated_cost_attempts, d.partial_cost_attempts, d.last_finished_at FROM app_generation_attempt_daily_stat d
d.stat_day >= DATE(#{startAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_character WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_character WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND private_card = 0 AND owner_user_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_character WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND private_card = 1 AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT c.user_id, c.character_id FROM app_conversation c LEFT JOIN app_conversation_archive a ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.conversation_id = c.id WHERE a.id IS NULL GROUP BY c.user_id, c.character_id ) t

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT c.user_id, c.character_id FROM app_conversation c LEFT JOIN app_conversation_archive a ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.conversation_id = c.id WHERE a.id IS NULL AND c.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY c.user_id, c.character_id ) t
SELECT GREATEST( COALESCE( ( SELECT counter_value FROM app_stats_counter WHERE counter_key = 'total_messages' ), 0 ), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_message ) )
SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT counter_value FROM app_stats_counter WHERE counter_key = 'successful_ai_responses' ), 0)

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(task_count) FROM app_generation_task_daily_stat), 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_generation_stat_event) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_generation_task t LEFT JOIN app_generation_stat_event e ON e.task_id = t.id WHERE e.id IS NULL )

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(task_count) FROM app_generation_task_daily_stat WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'), 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_generation_stat_event WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_generation_task t LEFT JOIN app_generation_stat_event e ON e.task_id = t.id WHERE e.id IS NULL AND t.status = 'SUCCESS' )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_payment_order WHERE status = 'PAID'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM app_payment_order WHERE status = 'PAID'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(day_key, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dayKey, DATE_FORMAT(day_key, '%m-%d') AS date, SUM(task_count) AS generations, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN task_count ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('FAILED', 'STOPPED') THEN task_count ELSE 0 END) AS failureCount FROM ( SELECT d.stat_day AS day_key, d.status, d.task_count FROM app_generation_task_daily_stat d
d.stat_day >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
UNION ALL SELECT e.event_day AS day_key, e.status, 1 AS task_count FROM app_generation_stat_event e
e.event_day >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
UNION ALL SELECT DATE(COALESCE(t.queued_at, t.started_at, t.finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS day_key, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.status, ''), 'QUEUED') AS status, 1 AS task_count FROM app_generation_task t LEFT JOIN app_generation_stat_event e ON e.task_id = t.id
e.id IS NULL
AND DATE(COALESCE(t.queued_at, t.started_at, t.finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
) s GROUP BY day_key ORDER BY day_key ASC

SELECT u.id AS userId, conv.conversation_count AS conversationCount FROM app_user u JOIN ( SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.character_id) AS conversation_count FROM app_conversation c LEFT JOIN app_conversation_archive a ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.conversation_id = c.id WHERE a.id IS NULL GROUP BY c.user_id ) conv ON conv.user_id = u.id ORDER BY conv.conversation_count DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.name, COALESCE(v.like_count, 0) AS likeCount, COALESCE(v.dislike_count, 0) AS dislikeCount, COALESCE(f.favorite_count, 0) AS favoriteCount, c.private_card AS privateCard FROM app_character c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT character_id, SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS like_count, SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'dislike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dislike_count FROM app_character_vote GROUP BY character_id ) v ON v.character_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT character_id, COUNT(*) AS favorite_count FROM app_character_favorite GROUP BY character_id ) f ON f.character_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(v.like_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(f.favorite_count, 0) DESC, c.sort_order ASC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH facts AS (
) SELECT stat_day AS dayKey, SUM(attempt_count) AS attempts, SUM(success_count) AS successCount, SUM(failure_count) AS failureCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(duration_sum_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(duration_sample_count), 0)), 0) AS avgDurationMs, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ttft_sum_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(ttft_sample_count), 0)), 0) AS avgTtftMs, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(completion_tokens, 0)), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost_usd), 0) AS totalCostUsd FROM facts GROUP BY stat_day ORDER BY stat_day ASC

WITH facts AS (
) SELECT provider_key AS providerKey, COALESCE(NULLIF(model, ''), 'unknown') AS model, SUM(attempt_count) AS attempts, COALESCE(SUM(success_count) / NULLIF(SUM(attempt_count), 0), 0) AS successRate, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(duration_sum_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(duration_sample_count), 0)), 0) AS avgDurationMs, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(completion_tokens, 0)), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost_usd), 0) AS totalCostUsd FROM facts GROUP BY provider_key, COALESCE(NULLIF(model, ''), 'unknown') ORDER BY attempts DESC, provider_key ASC, model ASC LIMIT 30

WITH facts AS (
) SELECT NULLIF(a.character_id, 0) AS characterId, COALESCE(c.name, '未关联角色') AS characterName, SUM(a.attempt_count) AS attempts, COALESCE(SUM(a.success_count) / NULLIF(SUM(a.attempt_count), 0), 0) AS successRate, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(a.prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(a.completion_tokens, 0)), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_cost_usd), 0) AS totalCostUsd FROM facts a LEFT JOIN app_character c ON c.id = a.character_id GROUP BY a.character_id, c.name ORDER BY attempts DESC, a.character_id DESC LIMIT 20

WITH facts AS (
) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(error_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS errorCode, NULLIF(http_status, 0) AS httpStatus, SUM(attempt_count) AS count, MAX(last_finished_at) AS lastOccurredAt FROM facts WHERE status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(error_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN'), http_status ORDER BY count DESC, lastOccurredAt DESC LIMIT 20

WITH facts AS (
), route_stats AS ( SELECT route_key, provider_key, SUM(attempt_count) AS attempts, COALESCE(SUM(success_count) / NULLIF(SUM(attempt_count), 0), 0) AS success_rate, SUM(fallback_attempts) AS fallback_attempts FROM facts GROUP BY route_key, provider_key ), configured_routes AS ( SELECT r.scene_key AS route_key, p.provider_key FROM app_st_model_provider p LEFT JOIN app_st_model_route r ON r.primary_provider_key = p.provider_key OR CONCAT('|', COALESCE(r.fallback_provider_keys, ''), '|') LIKE CONCAT('%|', p.provider_key, '|%') ) SELECT s.route_key AS routeKey, s.provider_key AS providerKey, s.attempts AS attempts, s.success_rate AS successRate, s.fallback_attempts AS fallbackAttempts, COALESCE(p.consecutive_failures, 0) AS consecutiveFailures, p.circuit_open_until AS circuitOpenUntil, COALESCE(p.last_health_status, 'unmanaged') AS lastHealthStatus FROM route_stats s LEFT JOIN app_st_model_provider p ON p.provider_key = s.provider_key UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(c.route_key, 'unassigned') AS routeKey, c.provider_key AS providerKey, 0 AS attempts, 0 AS successRate, 0 AS fallbackAttempts, COALESCE(p.consecutive_failures, 0) AS consecutiveFailures, p.circuit_open_until AS circuitOpenUntil, COALESCE(p.last_health_status, 'unknown') AS lastHealthStatus FROM configured_routes c JOIN app_st_model_provider p ON p.provider_key = c.provider_key WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM route_stats s WHERE s.provider_key = c.provider_key AND s.route_key = COALESCE(c.route_key, 'unassigned') ) ORDER BY attempts DESC, routeKey ASC, providerKey ASC LIMIT 30
